parameters.formDescription: One seed keyword in, a full market report out. Finds related keywords on Amazon, screens up to 6 markets, picks the winner with the screener's own ranking, and builds its ad-target list. Hard cap: 20 searches per run; pages and lookups from the last 24 hours are reused for free. The report is emailed and saved.

values.placeholder: optional, left out of the targets

parameters.jsCode:
// Listing rows from new searches only (reused pages are already saved)
return $('Toolkit Core').first().json.listings.map(json => ({ json }));

// One item per product page to look up (1 SerpApi search each). Products looked up in the last 24 h are reused instead.
return $('Rank Competitors').first().json.lookups.map(json => ({ json }));

parameters.content:
## i4 · Market Autopilot
Seed → Amazon autocomplete + saved suggestions (i5 code) → seed + top 5 ideas screened by the shared core (i1 logic, pages reused if < 24 h) → winner picked by the screener's ranking and tie rule → ad targets for the winner (i3 code) → one report: email, form, Autopilot Runs tab. No AI. Hard cap 20 searches.

## Search budget (max 20)
1 autocomplete. Pages get what is left after keeping 4 for lookups; extra ideas are skipped and named. Lookups get the remainder (max 8). Keywords that failed in the last 24 h are skipped, never paid twice.

## Winner = i1's #1
If #1 and #2 are within run-to-run noise (tied), the higher-confidence market wins and the report says so. Only the winner's keyword group feeds the targets.
